hypothesis: c025 (decay<=0.5, ignore_net_degree halved, adam scheme, per-net weight cap 15.68) is the strongest robust candidate; modestly relaxing the cap to ~31.4 (x2) lets the worst-path nets keep enough weight to further reduce WNS without losing the broad TNS gains, staying within the tested trend that relaxing the cap improved all cases.
analysis: The hypothesis holds: all three cases valid, positive score, robust mean +0.237, min +0.231. Relaxing the cap improved WNS and TNS broadly—bp_fe-ng45 shows the largest TNS gain (+32.3%) with WNS +17.2%, while ariane133 and bp show balanced ~25% gains. Mechanism: higher per-net weight cap lets worst-path nets retain influence, tightening WNS without sacrificing TNS. Overflow (~86–129) stays moderate. Next step: test cap=31.4 directly against c025 across seeds to confirm the x2 relaxation preserves robustness and doesn't inflate overflow.
